import sys, json, tempfile, subprocess, pathlib
def run(notes):
    t = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); d = t/'_backlog'; d.mkdir(parents=True)
    sp = {'id':'SP-aaaaaaaa','kind':'sprint','title':'s','status':'planned','goal':'g'}
    it = {'id':'ST-bbbbbbbb','kind':'story','title':'t','status':'draft','sprint':'SP-aaaaaaaa','priority':'P3','rank':0,
          'goal':'dispatch uses the form census.py dispatch uses for a rule',
          'checks':[{'run':['python3','-c','import sys; sys.exit(1)']}]}
    if notes: it['notes'] = notes
    (d/'SP-aaaaaaaa.json').write_text(json.dumps(sp)); (d/'ST-bbbbbbbb.json').write_text(json.dumps(it))
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','--root',str(t),'precheck','SP-aaaaaaaa'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    return [l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('warning:') and 'ST-bbbbbbbb' in l]
